messages:
Elaine (Finance): CostLens did a quick demo — looks promising for usage reconciliation. Can we scope a PoC? I need answers to procurement / billing mapping questions before we push an SOW.
Sam (Procurement): Thanks — quick checklist please: billing export format, sample data, PoC length & cost, termination notice, invoicing cadence, and any seat vs usage pricing tiers. Also SLA/credits.
Vikram (Eng): Does their export map directly to our invoice schema? We need columns for invoice_id, sku, usage_units, unit_price, cost_cents, and GL code mapping. If they can provide an S3 CSV or BigQuery export that's ideal.
Priya (InfoSec): Also need SOC2 report, encryption at rest + in transit, KMS/HSM details, and support for VPC peering or customer-managed S3 for exports. Any on-prem option?
CostLens-Sales: Great questions — happy to answer. We can provide a 6-week PoC: free credits for first 4 weeks, $4k flat for final 2 weeks of production testing (negotiable). Exports: daily CSV to customer S3, plus streaming webhook for events. We support seat-based dashboards + usage-tier pricing. SOC2 type II available, we use AES-256 and offer KMS integration.
Elaine (Finance): Can you share a sample CSV schema and a 7-day sample export? Also need to confirm invoice frequency (monthly), whether they can produce a combined invoice per customer, and support for our GL codes.
CostLens-Sales: Sample CSV (columns) attached in the demo follow-up. Example snippet:```date,invoice_id,customer_id,sku,usage_units,unit_price_cents,cost_cents,gl_code```We can map GL codes on export if you provide the mapping table. We support monthly consolidated invoices and can include invoice-level metadata (PO number, cost center).
Vikram (Eng): Quick request — can you include token-level breakdown for LLM API usage? We need to reconcile per-model consumption to our internal model catalog.
CostLens-Sales: Yes — model_id and model_version columns are available. We also include request_id for sampling.
Priya (InfoSec): Confirming VPC peering and private S3 export is in scope? Any SPL/SSO requirements?
CostLens-Sales: VPC peering supported for enterprise plans; SSO via SAML. For on-prem, we have a self-hosted agent for air-gapped environments (license + support fee).
procurement-bot: Reminder: Please attach a completed Vendor Security Questionnaire and Vendor Risk Assessment before legal review. Use the template in #procurement-resources.
Sam (Procurement): I'll draft a short SOW based on 6-week PoC with a trial export milestone and performance acceptance criteria (daily export + sample reconciliation checks). Need legal to confirm termination (30 days) and IP/data ownership clauses.
Elaine (Finance): I'll collect vendor answers and the sample export. Vikram can you test the sample against our reconciliation script? I'll loop in GL mapping.
Vikram (Eng): Yep, I'll run it. Send the sample to prod-ingest-sandbox S3 and I'll validate mapping + token breakdown.
Sam (Procurement): Next steps: Elaine to get vendor csv + SOC2; Priya to confirm security posture; Vikram to validate export; I will prepare SOW draft.
Elaine (Finance): Scheduling a sync with CostLens + Eng + InfoSec next Tue 11:00am PT — invite going out.
Sam (Procurement): Also confirm billing edge cases: credits, refunds, and overage handling. Ask them how they prorate mid-cycle changes.
CostLens-Sales: We'll include a billing FAQ covering credits/overages and prorations in the follow-up.
Elaine (Finance): Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam (Procurement): tagging @Legal when SOW draft is ready.
